size.label: Width (px)
size.description: Widget width; the height follows from the width and the font size.

interval.label: Redraw every (seconds)
interval.description: Mercury, the fastest, moves about 1 px every 10 minutes.

font.label: Font
font.description: Font family for labels and titles, e.g. "Noto Sans" or "Inter" (list them with: fc-list : family).

table_font.label: Table font
table_font.description: Font family for the table; a monospaced font keeps the columns tidy (e.g. "JetBrains Mono").

font_size.label: Font size
font_size.description: Size of the body text in px; headings scale along.

zodiac.label: Zodiac
zodiac.description: Where the signs on the ring and in the Sign column start: the equinox (tropical) or the stars (sidereal, Fagan/Bradley ayanamsa).

order.label: Table order
order.description: Heliocentric: the Sun, then Mercury, Venus, Earth, Mars… by distance from it. Geocentric: Earth first, then the Sun, then the Moon's nodes, then Mercury, Venus, Mars…

show_gc.label: Show: galactic center
show_gc.description: The galactic center (GC) on the zodiac band and in the table.

show_ga.label: Show: Great Attractor
show_ga.description: The Great Attractor (GA) on the zodiac band and in the table.

show_nodes.label: Show: Moon's nodes
show_nodes.description: The Moon's north and south nodes on the zodiac band and in the table.

zodiac_label.label: Show: zodiac label
zodiac_label.description: Show "Tropical" or "Sidereal: Fagan/Bradley" in the top left corner.

zodiac_font_size.label: Zodiac label size
zodiac_font_size.description: Size of the zodiac label in px, like Font size: the same number as Font size matches the date.
